Package com.csse3200.game.cards.play.integration

Class Team1EnemyStateAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.play.integration.Team1EnemyStateAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
EnemyStateView, EnemyEffectConsumer
public final class Team1EnemyStateAdapter extends Object implements EnemyStateView, EnemyEffectConsumer
Adapts Team 1 enemy entities to Team 5's read-only resolution view and result consumer.

Target IDs remain owned by the battle flow. The same IDs supplied by Team 3 in CardPlayTarget must be registered with this adapter.
